neighbours.label: token ' passed' for a law or motion being approved
fire: The motion was passed by the council on Monday.
The new budget passed in the state house last week.
Congress passed the measure after a long debate.
The treaty was passed by a narrow margin.
Lawmakers passed the reform before the summer recess.
The ordinance passed with only one vote against.
The assembly passed the resolution without amendment.
Parliament finally passed the act in March.
quiet: The motion was debated by the council on Monday.
The new budget failed in the state house last week.
Congress tabled the measure after a long debate.
The treaty was rejected by a narrow margin.
Lawmakers discussed the reform before the summer recess.
The ordinance stalled with only one vote against.
The assembly read the resolution without amendment.
Parliament finally received the act in March.

notes: Probes also fired ' at', ' to' and ' for' after event nouns and participles (0.38-0.70), not covered here, so this is a sub-trigger. ' passed' may be firing for any verb of approval; the near misses test that a little.
